#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => ? <(a)> ; [? <(b)> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha,beta,gamma
return

#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => ? <a> ; [? <b> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha,beta,gamma
return

#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => [? <(a)>,<(b)> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha,beta,gamma
return

#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => [? #<b> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha,beta,gamma
return

#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => [? <"b"> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha,beta
return

#command SHOW <!a!> [,<!b!>] => [? <(a)>,<(b)> ;]
procedure main()
local alpha := 11,beta := 22,gamma := 33
SHOW alpha
return
